gaps.lead: The police believe the two suspects left the country.
gaps.explanation: A present belief about a past event: are believed to have + participle.

gaps.lead: I'd rather you didn't tell anyone about this.
gaps.explanation: keep something to yourself = tell nobody.
last did X in (year) = haven't done X since (year).

gaps.lead: I only understood the pattern much later.
gaps.explanation: Front 'only + time phrase' forces inversion: Only much later did I understand.

gaps.lead: We couldn't go out because of the storm.
gaps.explanation: 'Couldn't go because of' → 'were prevented from going'.

gaps.lead: Although he is remarkably rich, he lives very simply.
gaps.explanation: Although he may be rich → Rich as (he) may be — fronted adjective + as + may.
